notes:
## New
- Setting names for offline use: while E-Sys runs with internet, E-Sys MAX fetches the setting names of every module of your saved cars ahead, so they are there at the car without Wi-Fi. Nothing to press.
- Newer cars that speak only DoIP: the fault scan, module info and battery reading now work with them too (Open Connection rows on port 13400).
- Welcome for new users: three steps from the first start to the first change, with the car connection check one click away. Open it again any time from About > First steps.

## Better
- Saved setting names stay on your PC, still encrypted, when the licence could not be confirmed for a while; they are there again as soon as it is.
